body:
The first thing I can tell you about these seeds is that there nasty to eat. And really not evan worth the nausea. I only got nausea from how the seeds taste.
It was 10:00pm and I and another friend ingested 500 seeds each. I almost puked just from how nasty they tasted.DO NOT CRUSH SEEDS UP AND PUT IN FOOD.chew them up
About an hour later I began to feel like I had just smoked alot of weed.there were no visuals yet. About 30 minutes later my friend started hitting me and trying to touch my face. This scared the hell out of me. I began to see vauge images of what looked like the grim reaper laughing at me. At this point I was almost crying. There is no way to describe the fear I felt.
Patterns and colores began to appear on the walls. And I was being held down by gravity.
The rest of the trip was really intence,not in visualls but just the way I was thinking. I felt insane. Like I knew what was real and what wasent but my mind kept on telling me what I was seeing was real.
If you are thinking about doing these seeds then think twice because its not like being high from weed. Its much different. You feel--> These seeds were not like being high from weed, it was much different. I felt uncomfterble.
